policies.title: proxy_pass target is built from client-controlled input
policies.description: Flags proxy_pass URLs whose host part is $host, $http_*, $arg_*, $cookie_* or a regex capture.
policies.rationale: A client-chosen upstream turns the proxy into a server-side request forgery or open-proxy primitive.
policies.remediation: Proxy to fixed upstream names or an allow-listed map.

policies.title: Upstream TLS certificate is not verified
policies.description: For https upstreams, checks that proxy_ssl_verify is on.
policies.rationale: Without verification the proxy accepts any certificate from the upstream path.
policies.absence_note: proxy_ssl_verify is not set; the module reference documents the default as off.
policies.remediation: Set proxy_ssl_verify on and provide proxy_ssl_trusted_certificate.

policies.title: stub_status endpoint is configured
policies.rationale: The status page leaks connection counts and should not be public.
policies.remediation: Restrict the location with allow/deny or serve it on a loopback listener.

policies.title: Invalid request headers are passed through
policies.description: Checks that ignore_invalid_headers is not off.
policies.rationale: Passing malformed header names to upstreams aids request smuggling and header-confusion attacks.
policies.remediation: Remove the directive or set it to on.

policies.title: Headers with underscores are accepted
policies.description: Checks that underscores_in_headers is not on.
policies.rationale: Underscore and hyphen header names can be confused between proxy and application.

policies.title: Access logging is switched off
policies.description: Checks that no access_log directive is set to off.
policies.rationale: Without access logs there is no record to investigate from.
policies.remediation: Log to a file or syslog target; disable only for health checks on a dedicated location.

policies.title: TLS session tickets are enabled
policies.description: Checks that ssl_session_tickets is not on.
policies.rationale: Ticket keys that are never rotated weaken forward secrecy; a published nginx advisory concerned ticket handling.
policies.absence_note: The default is on, with per-process keys that are not rotated.
policies.remediation: Set ssl_session_tickets off, or rotate ticket keys with ssl_session_ticket_key.
